annotations.title: Did it do what the receipt said?

description: After execution: give the executed digest and the receipt (its id, or the receipt object). tide reads the transaction from the chain and compares status, balance changes, objects and events with the receipt. Returns match, or each difference in one plain sentence to report to your human (also not_executed, or other_transaction when the signed bytes were not the receipt's). Example: { digest: "CRDt...", receipt: "8e56072be767fadb73a18169d8dcfc3c" }.
